instruction: Build a Docker image and push it to GHCR with login, metadata, and build-push actions.
output:
name: ghcr-push
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

instruction: Push an image to Docker Hub using username and token secrets.

name: dockerhub-push
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
jobs:
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/webapp:${{ github.ref_name }}

instruction: Build a multi-architecture image for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 with QEMU and buildx.

instruction: Build the image on pull requests without pushing it anywhere.
output:
name: pr-build-only
on: pull_request
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: webapp:pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

instruction: Apply semantic version tags from git tags with docker/metadata-action.
output:
name: semver-tags
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
jobs:
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}

instruction: Use the GitHub Actions cache backend to speed up Docker layer rebuilds.
output:
name: gha-layer-cache
on: push
jobs:
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

instruction: Build multiple Dockerfiles in the repo with a matrix of image names.
output:
name: dockerfile-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - image: api
            dockerfile: Dockerfile.api
          - image: worker
            dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: ${{ matrix.dockerfile }}
          push: false
          tags: ${{ matrix.image }}:ci

instruction: Authenticate to Amazon ECR and push the image with a commit-sha tag.
output:
name: ecr-push
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  ecr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ECR_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1
      - id: login
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.login.outputs.registry }}/webapp:${{ github.sha }}

instruction: Log in to Azure Container Registry and push the built image.
output:
name: acr-push
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  acr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/docker-login@v2
        with:
          login-server: myregistry.azurecr.io
          username: ${{ secrets.ACR_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.ACR_PASSWORD }}

instruction: Build in one job, export the image as a tarball artifact, then load and smoke-test it in another.
output:
name: image-artifact
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: docker build -t webapp:ci .
      - run: docker save webapp:ci | gzip > webapp.tar.gz
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docker-image
          path: webapp.tar.gz
  smoke:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docker-image
      - run: gunzip -c webapp.tar.gz | docker load
      - run: docker run --rm webapp:ci --version

instruction: Push the image to a GitLab container registry with deploy token credentials.

  push:
    tags: ['v*']

instruction: Build the image, run a container, and verify the health endpoint before finishing.
output:
name: run-smoke
on: pull_request
jobs:
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: docker build -t webapp:pr .
      - name: Start container
        run: docker run -d --name webapp -p 8080:8080 webapp:pr
      - name: Health check
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health && exit 0
            sleep 2
          done
          docker logs webapp
          exit 1
      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: docker rm -f webapp || true
